Bengal Minister Adhikari Appoints 11,000 Police Recruits, Promises More

West Bengal Minister Suvendu Adhikari has appointed 11,000 new police recruits and pledged to create an additional 13,000 posts by December. The Print reported that Adhikari assured transparent recruitment processes for state government jobs.
